decisions.statement: A one-click POST that reached the server is named as having reached it.
What the list did with that POST is what the server says rather than what we know.
A POST that never came back is named nowhere, because nothing here knows.
One-click is used only where the sender says one-click is offered.
A mailto is fallen back to where one-click is not offered.
A one-click POST that does not succeed is refused rather than passed over.
An unsubscribe by mailto names the message it sent on the list it is handed.

definition: getting off a mailing list by the headers the mail has
